description: Search Booksy for beauty businesses, browse by category, or fetch specific business details.

businessIds.description: Booksy business IDs to fetch details for (mode=byBusinessId). Find them in the Booksy URL, e.g. 688238 from https://booksy.com/en-us/688238_name
businessIds.title: Business IDs (mode=byBusinessId)

filterCategory.description: Filter results to a specific category slug (e.g. 'hair', 'nails'). Useful in search mode to narrow results.
filterCategory.title: Filter by category

isRecommended.description: If enabled, only return businesses marked as recommended by Booksy.
isRecommended.title: Recommended businesses only

latitude.description: GPS latitude for location-based search. Overrides the Location field if provided.
latitude.title: Latitude

location.description: City name to search near (e.g. 'New York', 'Los Angeles', 'Chicago'). Used when latitude/longitude are not provided.
location.title: Location (city name)

longitude.description: GPS longitude for location-based search. Overrides the Location field if provided.
longitude.title: Longitude

maxItems.description: Maximum number of businesses to return.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxRating.description: Only include businesses with a rating at or below this value (0–5 scale).
maxRating.title: Maximum rating

minRating.description: Only include businesses with a rating at or above this value (0–5 scale).
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviewCount.description: Only include businesses with at least this many reviews.
minReviewCount.title: Minimum review count

enumTitles: Search — find businesses by keyword and location
By Category — browse all businesses in a service category
By Business ID — fetch details for specific Booksy business IDs
mode.title: Mode

radiusKm.description: Radius in kilometres around the location to search (default: 10 km). This is a hint to Booksy's search, not a hard filter — Booksy may still include businesses outside this radius when local matches are limited (the same happens on booksy.com). Use the returned distanceKm field to filter strictly by distance if needed.
radiusKm.title: Search radius (km)

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search (mode=search). Examples: 'hair salon', 'barber', 'nail salon', 'massage', 'eyebrows'.
searchQuery.title: Search query

title: Booksy Scraper Input
